programmes.d: A dramatic plane crash finds Hobie and his mother trapped in a rapidly flooding fuselage.
Romance is in the air at Baywatch as Mitch and Jackie's friendship grows more intense.
John Cort returns to Baywatch where his life undergoes a devastating change.
Summer has love problems when Slade returns to discover Matt and Summer are dating.
A prison break gone awry finds Mitch held hostage and forced to perform surgery.
Mitch removes a bullet from an escaped convict, only to realize that he plans on killing him.
Mitch gets a surprise visit from his old mischievous Navy S.E.A.L. buddy and ex-Baywatch lifeguard.
A drifter torches Eddie's lifeguard tower which leads the team to discover an illegal drug lab.
Mitch saves two boys from drowning. But when one ends up in a coma, Mitch suffers from PTSD.
Mitch's birthday prompts him to train for an ironman competition, which causes problems at Baywatch.
A new lifeguard helps Mitch and the Baywatch lifeguards confront an upsurge in gang activity.
The Baywatch lifeguards stage a beach-oriented Special Olympics.
Jesse, a beautiful motorcycle racer, returns and puts strain on Matt and Summer’s relationship.
An ad hoc reunion of elite 1950s lifeguards, the "Red Knights," triggers a bar room brawl.
The Baywatch lifeguards travel to San Diego for a week where Summer is haunted by a ghost.
Adrift in the ocean with his semi-conscious brother, Mitch struggles to keep them both alive.
A beautiful woman and her plain sister compete for Mitch's affection with perilous results.
A reporter puts her life at risk to publish a story. Can the Baywatch team help her stay alive?
Country singer Jessie Lee Harris pays a visit to Baywatch in search of his estranged wife and son.
Matt and Summer volunteer their time when cutbacks put the Baywatch lifeguards’ jobs in jeopardy.
Stephanie spends a week with the Coast Guard to help them crack a dangerous arms smuggling ring.
Matt doesn't know whose story to believe when he tries to reunite a runaway teen and her father.
A Hollywood producer desperate for a new TV series idea observes a Baywatch rescue.
After a minor earthquake, a geological survey team arrives at Baywatch, but trouble strikes again.
Stephanie and the geological team are trapped underwater by a massive earthquake!
After the earthquake which almost took his life, Hobie leaves California to live with his mother.
John Cort shows up at headquarters and convinces Mitch to compete in a dune buggy race.
Mitch has to work a 24-hour shift with Stephanie and Hobie is pressured into throwing a house party.
Hobie befriends a boy who has moved to California to live with his father after his mother's death.
Mitch helps a woman he calls “The Mermaid” who turns out to be the wife of a crime boss.
